# LV24 SEO Optimizer Desktop

> A local, offline-first Tauri v2 desktop shell over the lv24-seo CLI engine; no cloud account,
> telemetry, local HTTP API or provider logic of its own.

## Docs

- [Architecture](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  trust boundary, single JSON envelope, engine resolution and version gate, config writes, signed updates.
- [Architecture details](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/docs/architecture-details.md):
  command-by-command bridge contract and argument allow-lists.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/docs/configuration.md):
  settings model, patch/backup/atomic save, reserved fields.
- [Security](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/docs/security.md):
  secrets, path approvals, CSP and update trust.
- [Release runbook](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/docs/release.md):
  versioning, CI gates, manual release, assets and rollback.
- [Current release 0.9.9](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/docs/releases/0.9.9.md):
  bundled engine 0.15.3 and known limits.
- [Documentation portal](https://seo.lv24.by/desktop/): desktop overview in English, Russian and Chinese.
- [Agent entry](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  commands, invariants, contract-drift rule, version checklist.

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer-desktop): source, releases and issues.
- [Engine repository](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer): provider adapters, crawl,
  reports, SQLite schema and write gates.
- [Engine MCP surface](https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-seo-optimizer/blob/main/docs/mcp.md):
  12 tools, 3 resources, 3 prompts.
